items.title: Why Regeneron (REGN) Is Up 6.7% After Mixed Q2 Results And New Telix Oncology Deal
items.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals reported past second-quarter 2026 results with revenue rising to US$4,290.7 million from US$3,675.6 million a year earlier, while net income slipped to US$1,296.9 million and diluted EPS from continuing operations softened to US$12.23. items.title: Regeneron beats quarterly estimates on eczema drug strength, shares rise
items.summary: July 30 () - Regeneron on Thursday beat Wall Street estimates for second-quarter revenue and profit, helped ‌by strong demand for its eczema drug Dupixent ‌and a high-dose version of its eye drug Eylea. Shares rose nearly ​5% before the bell.

items.title: Regeneron’s (NASDAQ:REGN) Q2 CY2026: Strong Sales
items.summary: Biotech company Regeneron (NASDAQ:REGN) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 16.7% year on year to $4.29 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $14.29 per share was 40.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
